comments.author: @Expatodyssey-n2y
comments.text:
Laos is a conservative country controlled by a communists  government. As a foreigner, you could be arrested  if caught with a lady from Laos in you room overnight  Most of the countries in Southeast Asia  are xenophobic to say the least....AND FOR VERY GOOD REASONS. You will encounter lots of smiling faces and the people are usually not rude. But the  simple fact is that, in general,  they want you to visit, spend and go. I have lived in Southeast Asia for almost 20 years. I love it here . I am not cynical but I understand the culture. If you are kind hearted, have money, are not rude,  bother  to understand the culture and   learn the language , at least some, life is good.  When you have an long term girlfriend from SEA or a wife, you must be willing to support the family. The women are expected to support the family.  In a traditional marriage in most of these countries the husband is expected to take care of his wife's family.  His sister will be the provider for your family.  When you marry a lady you are taking the families future breadwinner. The support you are expected to provide is not great be Western standard but necessary for the survival of many families. If you decide to pursue the long term relationship, you need to set bounds and limitation up front and not become a Foreign ATM......I AM not a B/S AI generated voice talking about someplace never visited....Been there, done that, got the tee shirt. 

Great Video. If you are contemplating going there long term, this  is very good small start
